title: Records Request - RFP No. 8120.1 Submitted Proposals

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Maryland Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

To the Montgomery County Public Schools Division of Procurement:

Pursuant to the Maryland Public Information Act, Md. Code, General Provisions §§ 4-101 et seq., I request electronic copies of all proposals and proposal responses submitted in response to RFP No. 8120.1, School Bus Stop-Arm Camera Safety Program, Equipment, Installation, Operation, and Maintenance Services, issued by Montgomery County Public Schools in collaboration with Montgomery County, Maryland.

Please include, for each proposer:

The complete submitted proposal, including all technical, management, operational, implementation, pricing, financial, and revenue-sharing volumes;
All appendices, exhibits, attachments, forms, schedules, and addenda included with the proposal;
Any clarifications, supplemental submissions, revised proposals, best-and-final offers, or other proposal materials submitted before award; and
A list identifying each vendor that submitted a proposal, if that information is maintained separately.

This request is limited to the proposals and proposal-related materials submitted by vendors. If any requested material is withheld in whole or in part, please provide all reasonably segregable nonexempt portions and identify the specific statutory exemption supporting each withholding.

Please provide the records electronically, preferably as searchable PDFs or through a download link. 

Thank you.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jon Smith

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Illinois Freedom of Information Act., I hereby request the following records:

The Village of Summit, IL's Annual Financial Reports and Annual Audits for Fiscal Years 2024 and 2025.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Samuel Girons
